summary.name: Lev Chizhov
summary.one_liner: Personal website of Lev Chizhov, founder of The Local Uploading Company, listing his neurotechnology work (ultrasound brain imaging and speech decoding) alongside essays, physics notes and side projects.
use_cases: read essays on rationality and neural interfaces
discover an early AI coding agent project
summary.what_it_does: ["This is a personal homepage listing projects and writing by Lev Chizhov, who says he is building The Local Uploading Company and working toward neurotechnology that preserves human agency.", "Featured work includes ultrasound-based brain blood flow imaging, decoding silent speech from ultrasound images of the tongue, and inducing smells with ultrasound, all under the Aleph Neuro label.", "Other entries cover topological analysis of calcium recordings from mouse visual cortex, metamaterials for physically unclonable functions, and notes on the Wolfram Physics Project.", "It also links short posts and essays on rationalist community dynamics, reward-center stimulation and wireheading, and a gallery of neuroimaging methods, plus side projects such as Clippinator (a 2023 coding agent) and an ML sticker bot with 200k MAU."]
notable: Ultrasound brain blood flow imaging and silent speech decoding from tongue ultrasound (Aleph Neuro)
Clippinator, described as the first coding agent back in 2023
Sticker creation bot reported at 200k monthly active users
caveats: Page is a personal portfolio of project blurbs; most entries give no implementation details, code, or availability.
No product pricing, download, or access information is stated on the page.
